answer: Paired live questioning makes each seat prove it remembers its own past. At a random moment, 20% of all seats are asked at once to state details from their own signed history, such as whether juniper or raven was among their seed words in a given epoch and what score they gave a graded answer, with 10 seconds to reply. One operator running 500 personas must keep 500 separate histories live at the same instant, since the questions land together. A rehearsed fable fails because every reply is checked against the ledger, and a wrong answer forfeits that seat's epoch payout.
